689:t_044:0.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, please save me! Please, have mercy on me!」

689:t_044:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Please tell me, $$マキ#pilot$$. Did you approach $n on $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s orders?」

689:t_044:3.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Of course! Because Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ chose me!」

689:t_044:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The truth is, it was because you worked at that hospital that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

689:t_044:6.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I-It's a lie! I am a chosen human! A being Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ promised eternity!」

689:t_044:7.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! My life belongs to Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...!」

689:t_045:0.en:
$n
「$$マキ#pilot$$... Maybe, because of me... $$マキ#pilot$$'s fate...」

689:t_046:0.en:
$n
「...I'll fight, Miss $$スズネ$$. To defeat the $$御使い$$s... to defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

689:t_046:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That your fight is my fight too.」

689:t_046:4.en:
$n
($$マキ#pilot$$... I will never forget you...)

689:t_046:5.en:

689:t_047:0.en:
$$真徒$$
「I-I am one of the chosen! Even among the $$真徒$$s, I am one who was granted $$ゼル・ビレニウム$$!」

689:t_047:1.en:
$$真徒$$
「Why!? Why would I fall to the likes of an inferior species...!」

689:t_048:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Pets take after their owners... The saying was right.」

689:t_048:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All you can do is look down on others. You are the same as the $$御使い$$s...」

689:t_048:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「See ya. If that's how you want to play it, we won't hesitate to fight.」

689:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're right, $$ザンボット$$! You and I have been together all along! We've gotten through the sad times and the hard times together!」

689:t_100:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Lend me your strength, $$ザンボット３$$! We'll join your power and ours into one and fight those guys!」

689:t_101:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'm the heart, you're the body... Now $$ダイターン$$ and I truly become one!」

689:t_101:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「The Sun is with us! $$ダイターン$$ and I will light up this $$カオス・コスモス$$!!」

689:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$トライダー$$! You are $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ itself - in other words, you are me!」

689:t_102:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You, me, and the company are one body and soul! Let's unite our hearts and power and protect Earth and the vault!!」

689:t_103:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I understand...! Through the $$Ｖコン$$, everything about $$鉄人$$!」

689:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$'s arms are my arms, my heart is $$鉄人$$'s heart! Now I myself become the Messenger of the Sun!!」

689:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「This infinite power...! The Photon Power of $$マジンガー$$ is flowing even into me and giving birth to hope!」

689:t_104:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「I... We are the Demon God of Light! Let's do this, $$マジンガー$$!!」

689:t_105:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So this is the $$ゲッター線$$...! This is $$ゲッター$$ Robo!!」

689:t_105:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Three hearts become one with the $$ゲッター$$ and advance toward infinite evolution! This is the $$ゲッター$$!!」

689:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゴッドマーズ$$, imbued with the wishes of my father on $$ギシン星$$... It's speaking to me...」

689:t_106:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「All of it becomes one...! The Six Gods and I become one, and the true $$ゴッドマーズ$$ is born!!」

689:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「You're right, $$グレンラガン$$! My journey has always been with you!」

689:t_107:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「You and I become a double spiral and break through even the apex of the heavens!」

689:t_107:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's the drill of you and me!!」

689:t_108:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「My body is on fire! This is the flame of $$ガンバスター$$!」

689:t_108:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It's hot...! This is the flame that that person entrusted to $$ガンバスター$$!」

689:t_108:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And now it merges with our flame and blazes up! As power that burns everything away!!」

689:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I understand...! I understand, $$ディスヌフ$$! I can feel you closer than ever before!」

689:t_109:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Thank you, $$ディスヌフ$$! You are my fight... you are me!!」

689:t_110:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Now, everything that forms $$ノノ$$... down to every last atom... moves under $$ノノ$$'s will!」

689:t_110:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Now, everything that forms $$ノノ$$... down to every last atom... moves under $$ノノ$$'s will!」

689:t_110:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Now, everything that forms $$ノノ$$... down to every last atom... moves under $$ノノ$$'s will!」

689:t_110:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ has been reborn! To fulfill my mission... to protect humanity!!」

689:t_110:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ has been reborn! To fulfill my mission... to protect humanity!!」

689:t_110:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ has been reborn! To fulfill my mission... to protect humanity!!」

689:t_111:0.en:
$$葵$$
「My body... is on fire! Everyone's feelings and $$ダンクーガ$$'s feelings become one and set me ablaze!」

689:t_111:1.en:
$$葵$$
「That's right, $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$! You're an heir to the blood of the beast, just like us!!」

689:t_112:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「I see! Yeah, that's right, $$ダイ・ガード$$! You want to fight to protect the peace too, don't you!」

689:t_112:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do it, $$ダイ・ガード$$! If you and we become one, there's nothing to be afraid of!!」

689:t_113:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see, $$ビッグオー$$. So you too, by nature, would rather not resort to force, just as I would not?」

689:t_113:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And at the same time, you answer lawlessness with lawlessness! You are truly myself, my friend $$ビッグオー$$!」

689:t_114:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Heh... Not just $$シルヴィア$$ and $$シリウス$$, even $$アクエリオン$$ has merged with me!? This is the best!」

689:t_114:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You shout too, $$アクエリオン$$! We're going to punch out our enemies!!」

689:t_115:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Now everyone, me, and $$アクエリオン$$ have become one! This is... infinite joy!」

689:t_115:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm not afraid of anything anymore! I... we are $$アクエリオン$$...! We become love that embraces everything!!」

689:t_116:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...This is... Unit-13...? What is this feeling...!?」

689:t_116:1.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Accept things as they are, $$シンジ$$. The EVA and we share the same wish to live.」

689:t_116:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Y-yeah! Right now... with this power...!」

689:t_117:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I can feel them! The people who put their wishes into $$ダブルエックス$$!」

689:t_117:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's do this, $$ダブルエックス$$! We're carrying the feelings of so many people!!」

689:t_118:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The machine and I are melting together, and something new is being born...!」

689:t_118:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Let's go! With this power, we should be able to protect something... the future!」

689:t_119:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What a strange sensation... More than feeling the machine, I no longer feel any boundary between the machine and me...」

689:t_119:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If this is the first step toward $$シンカ$$, I'll master this power!」

689:t_120:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「My consciousness is spreading out infinitely through the machine!」

689:t_120:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「With this power, we can keep fighting! People can become stronger!!」

689:t_121:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「My consciousness is reaching every corner of the $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$...!」

689:t_121:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's fight, $$ユニコーン$$! Our mission is to see what lies beyond human potential!!」

689:t_122:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$エクシア$$, $$ダブルオーガンダム$$, $$クアンタ$$... The Gundams that have fought alongside me...」

689:t_122:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I will become a $$ガンダム$$, and surpass the $$ガンダム$$! I... we are the power that opens up the future!!」
